question: Assume today is 2026-09-08. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the number of births registered in Taiwan in September 2026, as reported in the Ministry of the Interior's monthly household registration statistics.

target.what: Number of live births registered in Taiwan (Republic of China) during September 2026, as counted in the Ministry of the Interior's monthly household registration statistics (births registered in the month, by date of registration)
target.publisher: Ministry of the Interior, Republic of China (Taiwan) — Department of Household Registration, monthly bulletin of interior statistics
target.cadence: monthly, typically published in the following month (preliminary figures often released early in the following month)
target.caveats: Target period is future/incomplete relative to the 2026-09-08 cutoff: September 2026 has not yet occurred, so this is a forecast. Definition is registration-based (date of registration), not date of occurrence; late registration can shift births across months, though most births are registered withi

candidates.perspective: MOI monthly household registration statistics time series
candidates.hypothesis: September births registered in recent years (2019-2025) plus the 2026 year-to-date monthly pattern establish the level and the September seasonal factor; September typically shows a modest seasonal bump relative to August. Target = recent monthly level × September seasonal index, adjusted for the 2026 trend.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly registered births for Taiwan, January 2019 through the latest month published before 2026-09-08 (ideally July or August 2026), plus September values for 2019-2025. Minimum: 2024-2026 monthly series and the 2019-2025 September values.

p121.role: NDC 2026 medium-variant annual live-birth projection for Taiwan

methods.rationale: NDC medium annual projection (94,000) times September's share of annual births (~0.083). Cross-checks the series route from an independent annual anchor; failure mode is if NDC's annual path is misallocated across months.

methods.label: m3
methods.rationale: Own-history monthly series from Jan 2025 through Jul 2026; code picks a model (YoY growth estimate given <13 consecutive months) using last year's September value and the latest months' YoY growth. Shares inputs with m1, so treated as one route.

series_auto.rule: yoy3: last year's same month x the summed growth of the latest 3 year-on-year pairs

weight_basis.m1: B1 of 3 blocks; median of blocks: this block is the median
weight_basis.m2: B2 of 3 blocks; median of blocks: not the median (one vote, counts in the interval)
weight_basis.m3: B3 of 3 blocks; median of blocks: not the median (one vote, counts in the interval)

combination.weight_gate: off: inverse backtest-error weights need a bank-level gate (>= 30 scored questions with >= 2 backtested routes, hit rate >= 0.7; METHODS_ZH 4.1), which has not been run

interval.rule: several blocks: root mean square of the block widths, times the Birge ratio when it exceeds 1

baseline.rule: seasonal naive: the target's value for the same month last year

kept.name: September 2026 YoY change factor vs September 2025
kept.rationale: 2026 monthly YoY declines: Jan -772/9,495≈-8%, Jul -1,033/8,939≈-11.6%, H1 -9,031/55,375≈-16.3%. September 2025 was 8,603; a factor near 0.88 (≈-12%) sits between the July and H1 declines, reflecting continued but not accelerating decline.
kept.applies_when: September 2026 registration follows the 2026 YoY decline pattern seen in H1 and July.
kept.falsified_by: August 2026 births (published ~Sep 10) showing a sharp rebound or a much steeper fall than -12% YoY.

kept.name: September share of annual births
kept.rationale: From 2025 monthly table, September 8,603 / 107,812 ≈ 0.0798; September is typically near the annual average (1/12≈0.083) with a modest seasonal bump. Range spans 0.078-0.088.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence of a large shift in the 2026 seasonal birth pattern.

Main evidence: the estimate is anchored on last year's same month, [[p25_value]], scaled by recent year-on-year growth. July 2026 registrations were [[p89_value]] versus [[p27_value]] in July 2025, and the three-month YoY route uses [[p1_value]], [[p16_value]], [[p29_value]] and [[p28_value]]. Observed: the monthly registration counts and the annual projection. Assumed/transferred: the September share and the carry-forward of recent YoY decline.

Code combined three blocks with equal weight per block because methods sharing inputs were grouped, not treated as independent; widths came from benchmark calibration and Monte Carlo, not demonstrated accuracy.

Main risk: September 2026 is unobserved, and late registration or a shift in the recent decline could move the count. Better evidence would be August 2026 registrations and any early September figures.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.

The magnitude gate (v2.15d) asks the model once, without retrieval, for a rough estimate; whether the evidence-based estimate is more than 2x above or below it can carry the model's memory of the target into one repair. The rough number itself never enters a computation or a prompt; the estimate before that repair is kept in judge_rounds[-1].magnitude_checks[0]. The gate is off in the own-history ablation.
